subject: Observability & Eval discovery — Snowbank AI (recap + priorities)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@snowbank.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Liu <ava.liu@snowbank.ai>
Date: 2027-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro — observability needs for Snowbank AI

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking time earlier today. Quick summary from our side to make sure we captured the right context: Snowbank is building a multi-tenant retrieval-augmented assistant that serves financial analysts. Our immediate priorities are:

- Latency stability at 99th/95th percentiles for multi-turn chat (current P95 ~ 1.8s, P99 spikes during batch jobs)
- Cost visibility per request/route (we need token-level cost attribution)
- Regression detection when model/eval changes reduce answer fidelity for top customer cohorts
- Tight rollout guardrails — canary + auto-fallback to a cheaper baseline model without losing SLAs

Current stack: OpenAI hosted endpoints for generation; a custom vector DB on AWS for retrieval; logs flow into ELK; limited tracing between application and model calls.

Questions for Redwood: Do you support per-route cost breakdown, tracing hooks for KV cache hits/misses, and a way to surface golden-prompt regression alerts tied to eval sets? Also attaching our SOC2 questionnaire that security asked us to start filling out (SB-SOC2-questions.pdf).

Next steps: would love a short recap from you with proposed dashboards and what an eval-driven regression alert would look like. Can we get a short POC plan?

Thanks — Samir
Senior Platform Engineer
Snowbank AI

Attachments: SB-SOC2-questions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@snowbank.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — observability needs for Snowbank AI

Samir — thanks, that was a helpful list. Short recap from our discovery and proposed priority matrix below; I also answered your immediate questions inline.

Summary of pain & success criteria
- Pain: P99 spikes during nightly batch jobs and rollout regressions cause customer-facing quality incidents.
- Success criteria: P95 < 300ms for model-only latency on production routes; regression alerts that detect a >8% drop in top-10 QA prompts within a 24-72h window; per-route cost dashboard showing tokens and $/route.

What Redwood can offer (high level)
- Dashboards requested:
  - Route-level latency (P50/P95/P99), tokens-per-response, cache hit-rate, model variant breakdown
  - Cost view: token consumption mapped to routes and users, with hourly trend and anomaly flags
  - Eval panel: golden-prompt set results, regression trendlines, and example failures with trace links
- Tracing hooks: we provide a lightweight tracing SDK that can annotate application spans (retrieval time, model call, kv-cache hit/miss). These trace IDs map to the dashboard and trace viewer.
- Regression alerts: flexible rules (thresholds, rolling baselines) + optional blocked rollout if critical cohorts fail.

POC proposal (2–3 weeks):
1) Week 1: Instrumentation + tracing hook drop-in (Dev) — integrate tracing SDK into one non-critical route.
2) Week 2: Dashboard + golden-prompt upload (we'll work with your eval leads to map prompts).
3) Week 3: Alerting rules + canary policy test (synthetic traffic).

Immediate answers to your bullets:
- Per-route cost breakdown: yes — token and model-cost mapping surfaced per-route and per-API-key.
- Tracing hooks for KV hits/misses: yes — we emit a kv.hit/kv.miss tag per call.
- Golden prompt regression alerts: yes — tie eval pass rates to alerts, can be scoped to cohorts.

Next steps (action items):
- Dev: are you ok with a tracing SDK drop-in on a dev route? If yes, we’ll send the SDK and a short runbook.
- Marissa: I’ve cc'd Marissa to schedule a demo/POC kickoff next week.
- Samir: please share a short list of 15–20 golden prompts for initial evals (or we can use a redwood-supplied template).

I attached a sample dashboard preview (sb-dashboard-sample.png) for reference.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0199

Attachments: sb-dashboard-sample.png (image/png)

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@snowbank.ai>

Thanks everyone — Tue 7/19 10:00 PT works for us.

Quick clarifications:
- We'll share the golden prompts by Monday EOD (15 prompts), plus a smaller 5-prompt regression set.
- We can grant a read-only IAM role scoped to one ELK index and a single S3 bucket. I'll loop in our infra SRE to provision.
- On SOC2 doc: our security team would like a short timeline for SOC2 evidence-ready items — can Redwood confirm typical turnaround for audit artifacts (audit logs, key management attestation)?

Action items assigned:
- Snowbank: upload prompts + provision IAM (Samir/Ava)
- Redwood: send SDK runbook + meeting invite (Tessa/Marissa)
- Redwood/security: provide SOC2 evidence timeline (Dev)

See you on Tue — Samir
